scope: Read-only review of native host recorder and its focused tests against the accepted evaluation design; no host inference or bundle rebuild.

findings.title: Cold resume can add fresh inputs and copy an unverified predecessor
findings.evidence: The runner first seeds CASES[case].files, then overlays predecessor/project without verify_run. The record keeps only cold_predecessor name and preserves the original case_id/case_variation despite replacing the prompt.
findings.impact: A purported persisted-files-only trial can receive additional fixture references or changed historical output. Its case label does not identify a cold-continuation scenario, weakening interpretation and replay.
findings.fix: Validate a single predecessor attempt name, verify retained predecessor integrity before copying, skip fresh fixture seeding for cold runs, bind the predecessor record and copied artifact inventory hashes, and record a distinct cold-continuation case or explicit variation with source case.
findings.validation: Add a no-inference test that rejects a changed predecessor, asserts cold input files derive only from persisted artifacts plus declared session metadata, and checks distinct cold provenance.

findings.title: Scalar JSON output crashes final evidence recording
findings.evidence: outcome tolerates null/list/number JSON, but the observed-model extraction loop calls event.get without checking isinstance(event, dict).
findings.impact: A process that emits a valid scalar JSON line exits without record.json, losing its finalized execution status and evidence/artifact hash record even though launch and stdout remain.
findings.fix: Share a guarded dictionary-event parser between classification and model extraction, or guard event type before .get; preserve final receipts for malformed/unrecognized events.

validation.method: Called the actual run() with freeze, command discovery and evidence paths redirected to a temporary controlled fixture. The fake local Python host returned version fake-host 1.0 and emitted null; no LLM was called.
validation.observed_exception: AttributeError: NoneType object has no attribute get

findings.title: A changed tested package is flagged but discarded from retained evidence
findings.evidence: The final package inventory is compared with the frozen identity; only a boolean package_mutated is recorded. The following project copy excludes every pixl-kit directory, including modified package bytes.
findings.impact: If a model changes bundled instructions/runtime during a trial, the only retained package is the original. The actual changed bytes cannot be inspected or replayed, and profile/runtime identity fields continue naming the original package.
findings.fix: When package_mutated is true, retain the complete final package or a hash-bound set of changed/new/deleted files and its inventory; mark the run unsuitable for claims about an unchanged profile identity. Never overwrite the frozen baseline.
findings.validation: Add a fake-host mutation test proving changed package bytes survive independently of the frozen original and are hash-bound to the receipt.

verified_observations: All five current tests.test_host_evidence tests passed using uv run --no-sync python -m unittest tests.test_host_evidence -v.

codex-missing-01 and claude-missing-01 pass the current retained-file integrity verifier; both archived runner hashes match their recorded f189fe290f049ced7107a35855d3cb1f45cfa6c5e8b69288713d78a42221f423.
Codex completion is correctly host_completed_ungraded with observed_model null; permission failures do not become behavior passes.

No first-attempt package mutation was recorded; HOST-REC-003 is an untested failure-path gap, not a claim that those attempts changed the package.
limitations: Review covers recorder correctness, not grading of production behavior or artistic outcomes.
No new Claude/Codex inference calls, global setting changes, source edits, or bundle rebuilds were performed.
Line references and hashes name the reviewed version; later root-agent fixes require fresh focused validation.

followup_reviews.evidence: copy_inputs verifies predecessor receipts, rejects unrecorded artifacts, copies only persisted project inputs, binds predecessor record/artifact hashes, and run records an explicit cold-continuation phase/variation. Changed, newly added and deleted package fixture files are represented by a complete retained mutated-package inventory. Every retained file is included in evidence_hashes; the original baseline remains unchanged.
